request: 配置看门狗，超时时间 100ms，窗口模式
config:
```yaml
Wdg:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
  WdgConfig:
    - id: 0
      name: DefaultWatchdog
      timeout_ms: 100
      mode: WINDOW
      window_start_percent: 50
      enable_sleep_support: true
```

request: 配置双看门狗，系统看门狗 500ms，应用看门狗 100ms
config:
```yaml
Wdg:
  WdgConfig:
    - id: 0
      name: SystemWatchdog
      timeout_ms: 500
      mode: TIME_BASED
      priority: LOW
    - id: 1
      name: AppWatchdog
      timeout_ms: 100
      mode: WINDOW
      window_start_percent: 60
      priority: HIGH
```
